messages:
anya: Quick recap from last night's int4-v2 pilot at 10% — we observed a transient uptick in hallucination signal for the longform / system route. linking dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/longform-int4 :frowning:
raj: saw the spike too. seems bursty for ~15-25m windows. baseline ~0.3%, peak ~2.0%. metric=hallucination_rate_longform_system.
oliver: can we get a few failing pairs (prompt + model output) inline? need to triage whether it's corruption or model distribution shift.
anya: pasted 3 samples here and a gist with more: https://gist.github.com/redwood/longform-int4-samples. sample example:
```
ID: lf-4723
prompt (truncated): "Policy: acceptable uses include..."
model: int4-v2
output: "This policy forbids..." (contradicts source)
```
eva: quick theory: kv-cache get/put mismatch with int4 kernel on long sequences. we've seen token misalignments before when quantized kernel table wraps on certain offsets.
raj: ran quick A/B shadow (int4-v2 vs float16) on 2k+ context slice: concordance dropped, hallucination delta +1.7pp concentrated at seqlen>1800. BLEU delta small overall.
anya: what's the current automated gating? I thought the longform gate was +1.5pp over 10m for auto-fallback.
maria: config shows pilot gates: delta_hallucination > +2.0pp over 10m triggers alert only; auto-fallback=false for pilot channels.
ci-bot: notice: quiet-hallucination-watch fired for int4-v2 at 2026-03-20T23:45Z; delta=+1.95pp over 10m; auto-fallback suppressed (pilot mode).
eva: proposal: enable auto-fallback for pilot longform route but with conservative hysteresis: trigger when delta >= +1.2pp over 5m AND sustained for 3 consecutive 5m windows. fallback action: route traffic to float16 variant on the same model version. require smoke-eval pass before re-enable.
anya: also scope the signal to a route tag `route:longform_system` so other routes don't dilute it. add heavy-tail seqlen smoke test N=100 with seqlen sampled 1k-4k.
raj: i'll update canary-rule: add slice filter `route:longform_system`, threshold +1.2pp, window=5m, persistence=3. rollout plan: shadow for 30m then cut 5% for 1h if stable. firming target: 2026-03-21T09:00PT.
oliver: i'll own rollback runbook. steps: 1) flip canary to float16-wt on dedicated pool 2) set `kv_cache.disable=true` for int4 path 3) run smoke eval and compare outputs via diff script 4) collect sample csv and open postmortem.
maria: enabling auto-fallback flag for pilot longform now (will still require manual review to re-promote). notifying eng-oncall.
ci-bot: action: smoke-eval queued (job 84712). expected completion ~12m.
eva: adding the seqlen-heavy smoke test to staging; will run against int4-v2 and float16 baseline and paste results.
raj: note: if smoke-eval shows hallucination delta >= +1.2pp sustained, auto-fallback -> float16 and page eng-ml-oncall.
anya: thanks. let's reconvene after smoke-eval finishes or tomorrow 10:15 PT if still noisy. :thumbsup:
